newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT climbs 7.65 pct on peso plunge.
newsitem.headline: PLDT climbs 7.65 pct on peso plunge.

text.p: Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co jumped 65 pesos, or 7.65 percent, to 915 pesos on Friday on expectations that it would benefit from a weakening of the peso to the dollar, brokers said.
The Central Bank announced before the start of stock market trading that it will allow the peso-dollar rate to move within a new wider range.
"I think that's the major reason. The biggest beneficiary of a weakened peso are companies that earn in dollars like PLDT," said Joey Roxas, president at Eagle Equities Inc.
The issue reached a high of 935 pesos in early trade.
PLDT was among the top ten actively traded issues with 75.560 shares changing hands.
